newsitem.title: USA: Isolated thunderstorms in W.Africa cocoa areas - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Isolated thunderstorms in W.Africa cocoa areas - WSC.

text.p: West African cocoa-growing areas will be hot on Tuesday with isolated thunderstorms, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
The forecast is for mostly fair weather with a threat of a few isolated light showers over the next two days.
Thursday to Saturday will see very little change, with a daily risk of a few isolated showers, and temperatures up to the weekend will be near to above normal.
The region had isolated showers of 0.04-1.10 inches on Monday, with 10-20 percent coverage. Highs were 90-100 degrees F.
Dry, hot weather for most of February stressed trees in Ivory Coast, although scattered thundershowers later eased stress, WSC said. Drier and hotter weather has again developed.
